title: The Ownership Lesson
script: Anthropic's IPO filing shows sixteen point three billion dollars in revenue in six months. But the real lesson is who owns it. Seven co-founders hold fifty point one percent of the vote. Thousands of employees hold stock. Wealth like this doesn't come from a paycheck. It comes from owning a piece of what you build. So ask yourself. What do you own?
